title: Claude read-only Bash refusal names the `;`/line-break rule for a command reported to contain neither
outcome: Claude read-only Bash refusal names the `;`/line-break rule for a command reported to contain neither
acceptance: The exact bytes of the refused command from delegation-c89e8791 (or a faithful reproduction) are recorded, and the cause of the `;`/line-break reason is identified from source.

A refused read-only Bash command's stated reason names the rule that actually matched; a behavioral test drives the reported command shape (`cd <cwd> && grep -n "a\|b" <file> | head`) through the production policy and checks the refusal reason or the acceptance it now gets, with no text pinning beyond the rule identity.

If quoted `|` inside a grep pattern is misread as a pipe separator, the policy either handles it as quoted text or refuses it with a reason naming that rule; covered by a behavioral test. The candidate receives the standard review pair and full gate.
